clips.title: The story
paras: Talin Keeneye's dispatch is bound for Grelin Whitebeard's camp in Coldridge Valley. Carrying it down the southeastern road keeps the mountaineers in touch with Ironforge.

Couriers carry news through Coldridge Valley, where field scouts and sentries need word from the high passes and Ironforge. Anvilmar is the valley's administrative heart, but those posted along the trails rely on foot messengers to carry their dispatches.

Grelin Whitebeard keeps a small camp southeast of Talin Keeneye's post. Veteran mountaineers at these remote watchpoints face freezing drifts and trogg harassment, and depend on regular letters to follow affairs across Dun Morogh and the kingdom beyond.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: If I remember correctly, Grelin's camp is down the road to the southeast. No doubt he'll be eager to get his mail.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Is there something I can help you with?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ahh, excellent. It's been a while since I received word from Ironforge.
